title: Sealed Orchard
summary: Start: enter Sealed Orchard. The log opens the job and the helm marks Glass Choir Cutter 1. Do: come within 320 meters of that cutter. The wardens patrol the quarantine. Lamp-moth graves and illegal culture vaults are the reason the gate still shoots. Finish: after the cutter is met, come inside Dead Dome's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
